name: critic P15/P29/P31 round 1 — the real game: walk into a fight, use every command, win, level up, and count what it costs a child

steps.msg: the arrival card does not print the place name twice

steps.note: 1. THE SWIRL, timed with no screenshots in the way.

steps.eval: await (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); __DQ.encounterNow(); const m = {}; await new Promise(res => { const iv = setInterval(() => { const s = __DQ.state(); if (!m.battle && s.scene === 'battle') m.battle = performance.now() - t0; if (!m.menu && s.battleUi && s.battleUi.menu) { m.menu = performance.now() - t0; clearInterval(iv); res(); } if (performance.now() - t0 > 20000) { clearInterval(iv); res(); } }, 16); }); return JSON.stringify({MS_TO_BATTLE_SCENE: Math.round(m.battle), MS_TO_PRESSABLE_MENU: Math.round(m.menu)}); })()

steps.msg: the fight is staged on the map you were standing on
the cursor opens on Fight, not on Flee

steps.note: 2. HANDS OFF. 24 seconds with no input: the fight must wait for the child.

steps.eval: await (async () => { const n0 = __DQ.log(99).length; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 24000)); return JSON.stringify({HANDS_OFF_NEW_LOG_LINES: __DQ.log(99).length - n0, phase: __DQ.state().battle.phase}); })()

steps.msg: the game does not play itself

steps.note: 3. Every command in the window: Fight, target, cancel, Items, the bag, who for, Defend, Tactics.

steps.msg: cancel always gets you back out

steps.note: 4. THE PRICE OF ONE FIGHT: press only when the game is actually waiting, and count.

steps.eval: await (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); let presses = 0, last = null, still = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.scene !== 'battle') break; const line = String(s.battleUi.line || ''); if (s.battleUi.menu) { __DQ.press('confirm'); presses++; still = 0; } else { still = (line === last) ? still + 1 : 0; if (still > 6) { __DQ.press('confirm'); presses++; still = 0; } } last = line; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 90)); } const r = __DQ.battleResult() || {}; return JSON.stringify({PRESSES_A_CHILD_NEEDS: presses, SECONDS: Math.round((performance.now()-t0)/100)/10, outcome: r.outcome, rounds: r.rounds, exp: r.exp, gold: r.gold}); })()

steps.note: 5. THE IMPACT BEAT and the VICTORY BEAT, read frame by frame.

steps.eval: (window.__FX = {shake: 0, flash: 0}, setInterval(() => { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.scene !== 'battle') return; window.__FX.shake = Math.max(window.__FX.shake, (s.battlePresent.camera||{}).shake||0); window.__FX.flash = Math.max(window.__FX.flash, (s.transitions||{}).flash||0); }, 25), 'watching')

await (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 400; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.scene !== 'battle') break; if (s.battle && s.battle.phase === 'victory') break; __DQ.press('confirm'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); } return JSON.stringify({phase: __DQ.state().battle.phase, MAX_SHAKE: window.__FX.shake, MAX_FLASH: window.__FX.flash}); })()

steps.msg: victory gets a window of its own, not one line in the combat log box

steps.note: 6. A LEVEL-UP for real: grind instant fights until one levels Bram, then watch it at full speed.

steps.eval: await (async () => { let snap = null; __DQ.instant(true); for (let i = 1; i < 40; i++) { snap = __DQ.rosterSnapshot(); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {seed: i}); for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { if (!__DQ.state().battle || __DQ.state().battle.over) break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); } const r = __DQ.battleResult(); if (r && r.levelUps && r.levelUps.length) { __DQ.instant(false); __DQ.rosterRestore(snap); return JSON.stringify({LEVEL_UP_AFTER_FIGHTS: i, levelUps: r.levelUps}); } await new Promise(x => setTimeout(x, 30)); } __DQ.instant(false); return JSON.stringify({LEVEL_UP_FOUND: false}); })()

await (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 400; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.scene !== 'battle') break; if (s.battle && s.battle.phase === 'victory') break; __DQ.press('confirm'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 130)); } return 'won'; })()

steps.note: 7. THE SIGNATURE: does a monster ever ask to come along? 240 fights across the first four areas.

steps.eval: await (async () => { __DQ.instant(true); const areas = ['long_lane','saltmarrow_coast','whispering_wood','cobwell_manor']; let fights = 0, offers = 0, flags = 0; for (const a of areas) { for (let i = 1; i <= 60; i++) { __DQ.fight(a, {seed: i * 13, level: 6}); for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (!s.battle || s.battle.over) break; if (s.battleUi && (s.battleUi.offer || s.battleUi.waiting === 'recruit')) flags++; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); } fights++; const r = __DQ.battleResult(); if (r && r.recruit && r.recruit.offer) offers++; } } __DQ.instant(false); return JSON.stringify({FIGHTS: fights, JOIN_OFFERS: offers, OFFER_FLAGS: flags, friends: __DQ.state().roster.friends, wagon: __DQ.state().roster.wagon.length}); })()

steps.msg: at least one monster asked to come along in 240 fights (P17 owns the mechanic)

steps.note: 8. WALKING, uncheated: how often does a fight find a child in the meadow?

steps.eval: (window.__E = {ts: [], last: performance.now(), n: 0, t0: performance.now()}, setInterval(() => { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.scene === 'battle' && !window.__E.inB) { window.__E.inB = true; window.__E.ts.push(Math.round((performance.now()-window.__E.last)/100)/10); window.__E.n++; } if (s.scene !== 'battle' && window.__E.inB) { window.__E.inB = false; window.__E.last = performance.now(); } }, 50), 'armed')

await (async () => { const dirs = ['up','right','down','left']; for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.scene === 'battle') __DQ.press('confirm'); else __DQ.hold(dirs[Math.floor(i/14) % 4], 900); if (window.__E.n >= 3) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); } return JSON.stringify({WALK_SECONDS_BETWEEN_FIGHTS: window.__E.ts, fights: window.__E.n, walkedSeconds: Math.round((performance.now()-window.__E.t0)/100)/10, enc: __DQ.state().encounter}); })()
